<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=KC4ZRVh0Ei6hsKxzoZUP <nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FKC4ZRVh0Ei6hsKxzoZUP.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Drink </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/651079281882955787.png?v=1" alt="spiritualprayer" title="spiritualprayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1" alt="ripperscroll" title="ripperscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> special attack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809239255658587.png?v=1" alt="skulllantern90" title="skulllantern90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used to perform the 0 tick switch</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ T100 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266418218264694954.png?v=1" alt="shardofgenesisessence" title="shardofgenesisessence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> weapons are not required but will make the guide more consistent</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optionally switch to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/568262896375824385.png?v=1" alt="grim" title="grim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> p4 after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284342839513108.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofjas" title="scriptureofjas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> proc if seeking a PB</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
